# Anne Shirley & Barry

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Barry](../character/barry.md) — old friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P25](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0025)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to meet [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her mother. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) quickly become friends in the garden, solemnly swearing eternal friendship. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her new friend, and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) surprises [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a gift of chocolate sweeties.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P42](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0042)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tearfully explains to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that she accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) to ban [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with her. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to clear up the mistake, but Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) refuses to listen. Desperate, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) herself to plead for forgiveness, but is coldly turned away.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P46](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P57](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0057), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P62](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the past year since arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and recounts her imaginative adventures to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to run an errand to the Barrys' house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses she is terrified of crossing the spruce grove because she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined it was a haunted wood. To break her of this silly fear, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk through the dark woods anyway, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does in sheer terror before returning safely.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P34](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). They spend several exciting days enjoying the fair, visiting the park, and attending a concert before Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) drives them back home.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) bid farewell to [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reflects warmly on Anne's pleasant presence. The girls enjoy their scenic evening drive back to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) welcome her home with a hot supper.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

An Epoch in Anne’s Life P38](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0038)_

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.
>
